title: fix: make self-owned community model calls free
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Skips wallet and API-key budget deductions when a public community endpoint serves its owner
- Skips the circular 75% owner reward for the same request
- Keeps normal billing when another owner's endpoint serves a fallback

Tests: `npm exec vitest -- run src/byop-markup.test.ts` (26 passed); `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-gen`

Fixes #13700

gist.headline: The hive stopped charging itself
gist.blurb: Community model owners can now visit their own public endpoint without the wallet doing a tiny lap around the garden. No deduction, no circular reward, just the request getting on with it.
gist.summary: Public community endpoints now waive wallet and API-key budget deductions when they serve requests from their own owner, while preserving normal billing when another owner’s endpoint handles a fallback.
gist.impact: Community model owners can use their own public endpoints without spending budget or generating the circular 75% owner reward, while fallback requests remain billed normally.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a community model gardener tending her own code-plant at a public terminal, with a wallet resting safely closed beside it to show that self-owned requests do not trigger billing. A friendly CRT monitor robot can display a looping request arrow that gently stops before reaching a tiny Pollen jar, surrounded by flowers and vines; the scene represents avoiding circular owner rewards while keeping the shared garden operational.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener apron, tending her own glowing code-plant at a public retro terminal while a closed wallet and full Pollen jar sit safely nearby. A cheerful CRT monitor robot watches a request arrow stop before looping back into the jar, surrounded by flowers and vines on a prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, mint, and lavender background; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
